name: n3memorycore-lite
description: Ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 memory server for Claude Code, backed by Redis Stack. Persistence is disabled and enforced by the server (AOF off, RDB off) — use the paid N3MemoryCore for durable memory. Prerequisites: (1) Redis Stack on localhost:6379 (docker run -d --name redis-stack -p 6379:6379 redis/redis-stack-server:latest --appendonly no --save "") and (2) uv on PATH (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).
